C9000341.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 341 (Donaldson's hypersymplectic deformation conjecture.; papers: Deforming hypersymplectic four-manifolds to hyperkähler triples; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

MAIN_HK.statement: Manuscript thm:main: every normalized positive closed triple admits a fixed-three-class hyperkahler deformation.

TOPOLOGY.statement: prop:topology and lem:definite-pair: lattice alternatives and trivial canonical bundle.

TAME_CLASS.statement: thm:tamed-compatible and thm:taming-cone, including the prescribed-class conclusion.

FAMILY_CURVES.statement: thm:family-curves, with its marked families wall-crossing and Taubes-limit input.

ROOT_EXCLUSION.statement: prop:root-exclusion and prop:cup-product supply the curve-class restrictions used in Section 6.

CHAMBER.statement: prop:chamber-class and cor:curve-signs choose the primitive integral null class and exclude splitting directions.

CURVE_THEORY.statement: Standard factorization, finite exceptional set, positivity, adjunction, and genus-zero compactness inputs remain assumed here.

NONSPLITTING.statement: prop:nonsplitting: one reduced irreducible F-image through every point; distinct F-images are disjoint.

COMPACTNESS.statement: lem:pencil-compactness: marked simple F-spheres are compact without bubbling or multiple-cover limits, including finite-regularity family versions.

OZ_SCOPE.statement: Oh-Zhu 0805.3581v3 Sections 2-3 use unrestricted J variations and a low-regularity point-support reduction, not exact fixed-B pair variations.

JET_ALGEBRA.statement: Pullback, normal-residual, elliptic-symbol, independent-jet, and coefficient-period identities used in the restricted proof.
JET_ALGEBRA.note: The real Lean 4.31.0 compiler returned exit_code=0 and proof_holes=[] for this algebra only. The graph node remains open pending independent statement-fidelity review.

JET_ANALYTIC.statement: Classical finite-regularity elliptic, distribution, Sobolev, Fredholm, sphere-domain, and Sard-Smale inputs; not machine-certified here.

JET_OFFMARK.statement: For permitted exact primitives the off-mark annihilator is a linear combination of the two pullback-period functionals.

JET_POINT.statement: The point-supported remainder has no positive-order term; independent holomorphic and antiholomorphic first jets eliminate its zero-order term and the jet covector.
JET_POINT.note: Lean proves polynomial-symbol injectivity for arbitrary polynomial degree. The distributional comparison and off-mark reduction remain analytical arguments, not kernel-certified conclusions.

JET_PERIODS.statement: The two period functionals are independent and coefficient-sphere variations remove exactly them, without new solutions away from v0.

JET_UNIVERSAL.statement: The permitted exact-pair first-jet derivative has exactly the two period obstructions before augmentation and is a split surjection after coefficient-sphere augmentation.

JET_RELATIVE.statement: The augmented critical indices are 4 and 5, and relative Sard-Smale plus marked compactness gives smooth support-preserving immersion perturbations.

JET_LEMMA.statement: Conditional verification of lem:pencil-jets with fixed B, exact pair classes, positivity, immersed relative endpoints, retained spheres, and endpoint ordinary-node model subdisks.
JET_LEMMA.note: Engineer has supplied a complete conditional argument. No independent Reviewer acceptance, novelty determination, or verification of the upstream manuscript hypotheses is asserted.

NORMAL.statement: lem:pencil-normal and cor:pencil-node-count give regular torus neighborhoods and isolated immersed rational fibers.

NODAL_MODEL.statement: thm:nodal-model supplies the local ordinary-node fibration, fixed holomorphic volume form, and period-matched collapsing forms.

INSERTION.statement: lem:pencil-insertion glues exact nodal models while retaining the immersed sphere and keeping B fixed.

PENCIL.statement: thm:pencil produces the torus fibration with finitely many ordinary nodal rational fibers.

REG_PREP.statement: prop:regular-preparation preserves all three classes, nodal subdisks, and global regular-fiber averaging data.

AUX_VOLUME.statement: thm:auxiliary-solution solves the global closed auxiliary volume equation with the stated positivity.
AUX_VOLUME.note: The auxiliary audit addresses the conditional construction only. Its regular-preparation, local-model, and b-plus-three inputs remain explicit upstream obligations.

AUX_CONDITIONAL.statement: Under the stated prepared-fibration and local-model hypotheses, b-plus equal to three, and classical analytic inputs, every sufficiently small positive epsilon has a smooth equal-square closed auxiliary form with positive fiber sign.
AUX_CONDITIONAL.note: Engineer conditional proof only; normal independent Reviewer acceptance is required. Does not certify prop:auxiliary-class, a fixed B class, or the main conjecture.

AUX_GLUE_MOMENTS.statement: The invariant solution has the correct square and sign; both annular periods give a bounded exact gluing primitive, and the normalization imposes all three moments with exponentially small changes.

AUX_POLY_GEOMETRY.statement: Transported model cores, fixed regular charts, and fixed gluing annuli give polynomial metric, frame, inverse, cover, curvature, Sobolev, and multiplication bounds and exponential intrinsic residual.
AUX_POLY_GEOMETRY.note: Uses item iii of thm:nodal-model as an upstream hypothesis; does not assume lem:auxiliary-geometry.

AUX_EXACT_INVERSE.statement: The three zero means exhaust the harmonic selfdual cokernel by b-plus equal to three; Stokes and differentiated Weitzenbock give uniqueness, a uniform L2 bound, and same-order polynomial Hk bounds for the exact two-form.
AUX_EXACT_INVERSE.note: No family bound for a one-form primitive, Green operator, or positive spectral gap is assumed.

AUX_CONTRACTION.statement: Exact Sobolev iterates preserve all three moments; derived polynomial losses and exponential residual yield a small positive solution for every sufficiently small epsilon, with zero-residual and node-free cases included.

AUX_SMOOTHNESS.statement: The positive solution with a fixed Coulomb primitive has an elliptic square first-order system; finite-coefficient differentiation bootstraps to spatial smoothness at the one fixed parameter.
AUX_SMOOTHNESS.note: No simultaneous infinite-order small-epsilon threshold is required.

AUX_ALGEBRA.statement: The exterior-algebra, monodromy-rank, moment, Gram-adjugate, selfdual, gauge-symbol, boundary-sign, and contraction identities admit an exact symbolic replay.
AUX_ALGEBRA.note: Finite algebra only, not a machine proof of the global analytic theorem.

AUX_PRIOR_ART.statement: Donaldson math/0607083v1 Section 2 Proposition 1 and equation 3 establish the exact-form local framework and Stokes identity; Gross-Wilson math/0008018v3 treats integrable elliptic K3 geometry, not this extension.
AUX_PRIOR_ART.note: Source passages were read. Official canonical attribution remains for an authorized host Reviewer because its research/literature archive is outside this mission's writable paths.

AUX_CHAMBER.statement: prop:auxiliary-class gives one auxiliary class and epsilon uniformly transferring all later curve signs to [B].

ENDPOINT_CLASSICAL.statement: The Hodge, Kahler-class, prescribed-volume, and smooth-tamer inputs used in the final fixed-class endpoint path.

F341_OH_ZHU_SYMBOL_COLLISION.statement: In 07-pencil.tex of OpenAI Family 341 (Donaldson hypersymplectic deformation), Oh-Zhu (arXiv:0805.3581v3) equation (2.18) directly implies off-mark vanishing of the cokernel for exact pair variations (d beta_A, d beta_C) with fixed two-form B.

F341_OH_ZHU_SOBOLEV_DELTA_ORDER.statement: In 07-pencil.tex of OpenAI Family 341, Oh-Zhu Section 3 equation (3.3) and Remark 3.2 (which use the dual of W^{1,p}) directly imply that a point-supported annihilator distribution on the higher-order first-jet target space is a scalar multiple of the zero-order delta distribution by Sobolev order alone.
